text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: the share of hours whose measured power falls inside the forecast band, the range between the forecast's 10% and 90% quantiles (dashed line: the nominal 80%). Bottom: the mean width of the forecast band, in percentage points of capacity. Each group of bars is one range of forecast sky (clear, mixed, cloudy, or all hours): the weather forecast's clear- sky index, its irradiance as a share of clear-sky irradiance.'

g.aria-label: Symbol legend titled 'B0 (no lag) or L1 (one lag)' for fill color with 2 values: B0, L1

text.font-family: Matter Semi Mono, Roboto Mono, monospace
Matter Semi Mono, Roboto Mono, monospace

text.aria-label: Title text 'The forecasts are out-of-fold: each is made by an XGBoost model that never trained on that month, with whole blocks of months (folds) held out in turn. The forecasts are at lead-day 1, for the day after the day of issue, from one training run (fitting seed). Descriptive: no planned contrast rests on this figure. Arms. B0: the XGBoost baseline with no lagged power. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the forecast was issued (two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast).'
